cases.query: How does hermes retrieval harness score chunks?
cases.answer: The hermes retrieval harness scores path tokens highest, then headers, then text matches, with co-occurrence bonuses before returning top-k citations.
sources: Retrieval scoring — path tokens are weighted most heavily, then headers, then exact text, then fuzzy substring matches. A co-occurrence bonus rewards chunks that cover multiple query aspects.
